gloss: one round; one size (bigger/smaller); one cycle (of zodiac)

definitions.gloss: one round, one lap, full circuit
definitions.explanation: Going around something once, completing a full circle or tour.
A noticeable difference in size, used to describe something or someone as distinctly larger or smaller than a reference point.
A full cycle of the Chinese zodiac, equal to 12 years. Used when describing age differences.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}を{一回|ひとまわ}りした。
examples.english: I went around the park once.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}を{一回|ひとまわ}りして{戻|もど}ってきた。
examples.english: I took a walk around the town and came back.

examples.japanese: {観光地|かんこうち}を{一回|ひとまわ}りするのに{半日|はんにち}かかった。
examples.english: It took half a day to make one tour of the tourist spots.

examples.japanese: {一回|ひとまわ}り{大|おお}きいサイズをください。
examples.english: Please give me a size one larger.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{私|わたし}より{一回|ひとまわ}り{体|からだ}が{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: My younger brother is noticeably bigger than me.

examples.japanese: このシャツは{一回|ひとまわ}り{小|ちい}さくなった{気|き}がする。
examples.english: This shirt feels like it shrank a size.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}は{私|わたし}より{一回|ひとまわ}り{上|うえ}だ。
examples.english: My husband is one zodiac cycle (12 years) older than me.

examples.japanese: {一回|ひとまわ}り{年下|としした}の{後輩|こうはい}と{結婚|けっこん}した。
examples.english: I married a junior colleague who is 12 years younger.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}とは{干支|えと}が{同|おな}じで{一回|ひとまわ}り{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: She and I share the same zodiac sign but are one full cycle apart.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 is very common in everyday speech. {一回|ひとまわ}り{大|おお}きい and {一回|ひとまわ}り{小|ちい}さい are the most frequent collocations. The size difference is approximate and subjective rather than a precise measurement.

Sense 3 specifically refers to the 12-year Chinese zodiac cycle ({干支|えと}). {一回|ひとまわ}り{上|うえ}/{下|した} is a common way to describe a 12-year age gap.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一回|ひとまわ}り{大|おお}きい: one size bigger
- {一回|ひとまわ}り{小|ちい}さい: one size smaller
- {一回|ひとまわ}り{上|うえ}: 12 years older
- {一回|ひとまわ}り{下|した}: 12 years younger
- {一回|ひとまわ}りする: to go around once
